lines.t: 🎶 Music Outro 🎶
I kept chasing every feeling
Calling all my impulses free
But every road I ran down
Took a little more from me
I was heavy with my choices, pulling further day by day
Till a whisper in the silence showed an arrow bright away
It said lay down what is killing you, all the weight you never had to hold
Turn your face toward the promised child, let my hand be your strong road

I am stronger when I obey. Braver when I yield my say. Every time I choose your will, something in my heart is healed. I thought surrender meant I'd break, but it's where my chains give way. I am weakest when I stray. I am stronger when I obey.
There's a war inside my thinking
Old desires dressed up as light
They are loud when I am weary
They look softer in the night
But your kindness cuts right through them
Like a sword that knows what's true
You don't drive me with a threat
You just say walk close and new
So I bring you all my questions, all the battles I can't seem to win
And you don't turn away from me, you teach my feet to stand again
I am stronger when I obey, braver when I yield my say
Every time I choose your will, something in my heart is healed
I thought surrender meant I'd break
But it's where my chains give away
I am weakest when I stray
I am stronger when I obey
It's not fear that keeps me near you
It's the love that took my blame
You were wounded for my wandering
Now your scars call out my name
So when my doubts rise up like giants and my failures shout me down
I will answer with obedience, lift my eyes and stand my ground
Every yes becomes an altar, every notice in a door
I lose pieces of my old life
But I'm finding you much more
I am stronger when I obey
Braver when I yield my say
Every time I choose your will
Something in my heart is healed
You turn trembling into song
Teach my rebel heart to stay
I am weakest when I stray
But with you I'll stand and say
I am stronger when I obey
